beside-not-inside.title: Beside, not inside
beside-not-inside.script: Now the other home: project details that stay outside the skill, in project files it reads when it runs. The procedure goes inside, and whatever changes from one project to the next stays beside.

where-it-gets-shared.title: Where it gets shared
where-it-gets-shared.script: And who uses the skill decides how much care it needs. A skill for your own use can be loose, and a skill a colleague runs needs more, which sets up the next Section.
